author: WPB7
summary: The Bible repository README: book build, sealed-artifact reproducibility, HTML edition, repository guide and contribution rules. Almost all of it is book production and is historical; its technical content (the snapshot framing and the alpha.1 C API compile blocker) is already on the site at 009d40f5. Its evidence rules for examples and screenshots were added to the compatibility-and-evidence deep dive.

concepts.text: The manuscript's build needs latexmk, pdflatex and makeindex, and its full verifier adds Poppler, MuPDF, Ghostscript, Netpbm, Perl and util-linux flock; tools/verify-book.sh and tools/build-release.sh are the book's own build and verification entry points.
concepts.note: Production tooling of the book, not CNA; nothing here describes CNA behaviour.

concepts.text: The sealed alpha.1 edition of the book is a 2,602,878-byte PDF with a fixed SHA-256 and PDF dates from SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1787253313; two clean builds were byte-identical and the release script restores the previous artifact on any failure.
concepts.note: Reproducibility record of the book artifact; no CNA fact.

concepts.text: The book was also published as a LaTeXML-generated static HTML edition under docs/, rebuilt by tools/html/build.sh with its own coverage verifier.
concepts.note: Publication pipeline of the book; superseded as a reader surface by this site.

concepts.text: The repository guide assigns roles to PLAN.md (plan and verification history), NEXT.md (handoff), EDITORIAL-AUDIT.md, CLAUDE.md (conventions), PROGRESS.md (superseded two-volume record), the screenshot infrastructure, verify-edition-facts.sh and the artifact lock helper.
concepts.note: Navigation of the book repository; process documents are recorded under their own units.

concepts.text: The manuscript identified its source as an unsealed CNA development snapshot later than the v0.1.0-alpha.1 tag (1bb2145d) that still encodes product version 0.1.0-alpha.1, and stressed that neither fact makes the snapshot a new release.
tokens: cannot tell the two revisions apart

target.evidence: docs/releases.html (checked at 009d40f5); CMakeLists.txt project VERSION and cmake/Version.cmake at 009d40f5

concepts.note: The framing holds at 009d40f5; the site documents 009d40f5 (2,877 commits after the tag), not the manuscript's older pin.

concepts.text: At the alpha.1 tag the experimental C API's final library target could not compile: its renderer table had 49 rows against 50 canonical identities, so the header/source inventory existed but cna_c_api was not a consumable alpha.1 artifact.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 the table has 25 rows for 25 identities; the site states that the fix is source-level and not build-verified.

concepts.text: Contribution rules: claims must be checked against the pinned CNA source, tests or authoritative plans; code examples must be real and compilable; screenshots must come from an actual running build, never a mock-up.
tokens: a screenshot is evidence only for the revision
concepts.note: The site already had the source-verified evidence basis; WPB7 added the example classes and the screenshot rule (wpb7-claim-scopes).
